fields.Name: CreateJournalEntry
fields.Description: Posts a balanced journal entry to the company's ERP. Routes to the plugin for the company's accounting connection (QuickBooks Online or Business Central), chosen by CompanyIntegrationID, else by IntegrationName, else the company's single active ERP connection. Every other input param is passed to that plugin unchanged, and the plugin's output params are returned.

fields.Name: CompanyID
fields.Description: ID of the MJ Company whose ERP connection to use.

fields.Name: CompanyIntegrationID
fields.Description: Optional ID of the Company Integration (ERP connection) to use. Required when the company has more than one active connection for the same ERP. Must belong to CompanyID and be active.

fields.Name: IntegrationName
fields.Description: Optional ERP Integration name (e.g. 'QuickBooks Online' or 'Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central') used to pick the connection when CompanyIntegrationID is not given.
